# Download CoreUI Angular Templates

> Download CoreUI Angular Admin Templates to get the source code that lets you customize and create your angular-based application.

## Source files

Compile CoreUI Angular Admin Dashboard with your own asset pipeline by downloading our source Scss, and TypeScript files. This option requires some additional tooling:

- Angular
- Angular CLI
- Angular CDK
- Angular Router
- RxJS

<a href="https://coreui.io/product/free-angular-admin-template/" class="btn btn-primary" target="_blank">Download</a>

### Clone repo

You can also fork [CoreUI Free Angular Admin Template](https://github.com/coreui/coreui-free-angular-admin-template) repository.

via HTTPS:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/coreui/coreui-free-angular-admin-template.git
```

or via SSH:
```bash
git clone git@github.com:coreui/coreui-free-angular-admin-template.git
```

<br />
<br />

If you have a valid __Enterprise subscription__ you can fork **CoreUI PRO Angular Admin Template** repository.

via HTTPS:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/coreui/coreui-pro-angular-admin-template
```

or via SSH:

```bash
git clone git@github.com:coreui/coreui-pro-angular-admin-template.git
```
